name: assert-open-seam
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.rail-assistant-toggle');const p=document.querySelector('.live-assistant.is-open');if(b&&p){const br=b.getBoundingClientRect(),pr=p.getBoundingClientRect();if(Math.abs(br.left+br.width/2-pr.left)<3){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);resolve({button:br.toJSON(),panel:pr.toJSON()})}}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Open assistant seam misaligned'))},6000);check();})

name: assert-edge-reopen-button
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Expand assistant rail"]');if(b&&document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-right-menu-collapsed')==='true'){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.left>=innerWidth-60){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);resolve({button:r.toJSON(),viewport:innerWidth})}}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Collapsed edge control missing'))},6000);check();})

name: assert-reopened
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{if(document.querySelector('.live-assistant.is-open')&&document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Collapse assistant rail"]')&&document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-right-menu-collapsed')==='false'){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);resolve(true)}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Edge did not reopen assistant'))},6000);check();})
